purpose: Binds stateful classes to tagged Roblox Instances and owns their creation, observation, lookup, and cleanup lifecycles.
description: Binds stateful classes to tagged Roblox Instances and owns their creation, observation, lookup, and cleanup lifecycles.

Shared/Binder.luau.description: Bind class to Roblox Instance Public entry points include `MyClass.new`, `MyClass.Destroy`, `Binder.isBinder`, `Binder.Init`, `handleNewClass`, `handleClassChanged`.

Shared/BinderGroup.luau.description: Groups binders together into a list, and allows binders to be dynamically added or removed. Also allows their interface to be validated using a validation function. This ensures that all added objects are the same type, so they can be used for dynamic interactions. Public entry points include `BinderGroup.new`, `BinderGroup.AddList`, `BinderGroup.Add`, `BinderGroup.GetBinders`.

Shared/BinderGroupProvider.luau.description: Provides a basis for binderGroups that can be retrieved anywhere Public entry points include `BinderGroupProvider.new`, `BinderGroupProvider.PromiseGroupsAdded`, `BinderGroupProvider.Init`, `BinderGroupProvider.Start`, `BinderGroupProvider.Get`, `BinderGroupProvider.Add`, `BinderGroupProvider.Destroy`.

Shared/BinderProvider.luau.description: Provides a basis for binders that can be retrieved anywhere Public entry points include `BinderProvider.new`, `BinderProvider.isBinderProvider`, `BinderProvider.PromiseBinder`, `BinderProvider.Init`, `BinderProvider.PromiseBindersAdded`, `BinderProvider.PromiseBindersStarted`, `BinderProvider.Start`, `BinderProvider.Get`.

Shared/Collection/BoundChildCollection.l.description: Tracks child of type of a binder.
Tracks child of type of a binder.

Shared/Internal/PlayerBinder.luau.description: Binds the given class to each player in the game Public entry points include `PlayerBinder.new`, `PlayerBinder.Start`.

Shared/Internal/PlayerCharacterBinder.lu.description: Binder that will automatically bind to each player's character Public entry points include `PlayerCharacterBinder.new`, `PlayerCharacterBinder.Init`, `PlayerCharacterBinder.SetAutomaticTagging`, `PlayerCharacterBinder.ObserveAutomaticTagging`, `PlayerCharacterBinder.ObserveAutomaticTaggingBrio`, `PlayerCharacterBinder.Start`.

Shared/Internal/PlayerHumanoidBinder.lua.description: Binder that will automatically bind to each player's humanoid Public entry points include `PlayerHumanoidBinder.new`, `PlayerHumanoidBinder.Init`, `PlayerHumanoidBinder.SetAutomaticTagging`, `PlayerHumanoidBinder.ObserveAutomaticTagging`, `PlayerHumanoidBinder.ObserveAutomaticTaggingBrio`, `PlayerHumanoidBinder.Start`.

Shared/Promise/promiseBoundClass.luau.description: Utility function to promise a bound class on an object.

Shared/Trackers/BoundAncestorTracker.lua.description: Tracks a parent bound to a specific binder Public entry points include `BoundAncestorTracker.new`.

Shared/Trackers/BoundParentTracker.luau.description: Tracks a parent bound to a specific binder Public entry points include `BoundParentTracker.new`.
